parameters.name: AccelerateStorageSize
parameters.description: The acceleration storage space for Basic Edition with acceleration enabled. Unit: GB.

parameters.name: AccelerateSwitch
parameters.description:
The acceleration mode. Valid values:

- **ONLY**: enables acceleration only.
- **ON**: enables cold data storage and acceleration.

parameters.name: AccelerateType
parameters.description:
The acceleration type. Valid values: 

- **juice**: file system acceleration.
- **alluxio**: transparent acceleration.

parameters.name: AuthorizedUserIds
parameters.description: The list of authorized account IDs for Cold Storage Edition instances, separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

- **true**: Auto-renewal is enabled.
- **false**: Auto-renewal is disabled.

Default value: **false**.

> This parameter takes effect only when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**.

parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
- **true**: Coupons are used (default).
- **false**: Coupons are not used.

parameters.name: CreationCategory
parameters.description:
The edition. Valid values:

- **basic**: Basic Edition (default).
- **cold**: Cold Storage Edition.
- **high_performance**: High-performance Edition.

parameters.name: CustomBucketCount
parameters.description:
The number of buckets.

> This parameter is required only when acceleration (file system acceleration) is enabled.

parameters.name: CustomBucketPath
parameters.description:
The bucket path.

> This parameter is required only when acceleration (file system acceleration) is enabled.

parameters.name: CustomBucketPathList
parameters.description:
The bucket and path information.

> This parameter is required for transparent acceleration scenarios.

parameters.name: CustomOssAk
parameters.description: The custom AccessKey ID.

parameters.name: CustomOssSk
parameters.description: The custom AccessKey secret.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The cluster ID.

parameters.name: DBType
parameters.description:
The database engine. Valid values:
- **MySQL**
- **PostgreSQL**

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values: 

- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.
- **Prepaid**: subscription.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
This parameter is required when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**. Specifies whether the subscription cluster uses a yearly or monthly billing cycle. You must pass this parameter when the billing method is subscription. 

- **Year**: The subscription period is measured in years.
- **Month**: The subscription period is measured in months.

parameters.name: PromotionCode
parameters.description: The coupon code. If this parameter is not specified, the default coupon is used.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.
>You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query region IDs.

parameters.name: StorageSpace
parameters.description: The storage space. Unit: GB.

parameters.name: StorageType
parameters.description:
Valid values for high-performance storage type:
- **ESSDPL0**
- **ESSDPL1**

Valid values for Basic Edition storage type:
- **city_redundancy (zone-redundant)**

Valid values for Cold Storage Edition storage type:
- **city_redundancy (zone-redundant)**
- **local_redundancy (locally redundant)**

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description:
This parameter is required when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**.
- When **Period** is set to **Month**, the valid values of **UsedTime** are integers in the range of `[1-9]`.
- When **Period** is set to **Year**, the valid values of **UsedTime** are integers in the range of `[1-3]`.

parameters.name: VPCId
parameters.description: The VPC ID.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID.
